_comment: Tier-2 for dune::helmholtz#1, #4 and maxwell#2 — one 40x40 grid, k a dune.ufl.Constant so the sweep is free, two compiled modules (P1 and P3). Exact plane wave u = sin(k x) imposed on the whole boundary, so the discrete error IS the phase/amplitude error. Measured 2026-08-06 (dune-fem 2.12.0.2): relative L2 error 1.117784e-01 at 20 elements per wavelength (k=12.57), 6.259823e-01 at 10 (k=25.13), 9.543712e-01 at 4 (k=62.83) — strictly monotone in resolution, and below five elements per wavelength the error is far past 'tens of per cent'. On the SAME mesh at k=62.83, P3 gives 4.604336e-02 against P1's 9.543712e-01, a factor of 21. NUMBERS IN THE CLAIMS THAT DO NOT HOLD, recorded rather than asserted: helmholtz#4's 'ten P1 elements per wavelength for about one per cent' is off by two orders of magnitude here (62.6%), and helmholtz#1's 'P3 recovers phase to < 0.1%' is 4.6%. The DIRECTION both claims describe is what this fixture gates: error falls with resolution per wavelength, and raising the order on a fixed mesh recovers an order of magnitude. That the absolute numbers are so much worse at these wavenumbers is itself the pollution effect helmholtz#1 is about. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 runs the elements-per-wavelength sweep on the P3 space instead of the P1 one, removing the under-resolved low-order discretisation. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'p1_below_5_per_wavelength_is_tens_of_percent=True', 'dune_pollution_and_resolution_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
